On it. Draft checklist (to be refined):
- Logs: Remove or replace IPs and user IDs; replace with stable pseudonyms (e.g., user_abc123). Include UTC timestamp window. Provide a SHA256 digest of the file.
- Telemetry extracts: Provide a SHA256 hash of raw files; submit hashed identifiers only. Include sampling method (random seed + rate) in the readme.
- Screenshots: Blur or black-box PII; if redaction obscures context needed for the control, provide a second annotated screenshot with a caption explaining the redaction.
- KMS/key logs: Submit metadata export (no secret material); include rotation entries and attest that keys were managed in a hardware-backed KMS.

Key acceptance checklist (copy):
- File formats: JSON, CSV, PDF; compressed archives ok (.zip, .tar.gz).
- Integrity: Provide SHA256 digest for each artifact in the manifest; we verify digests at intake.
- Timestamping: Use UTC ISO8601 timestamps; include collection window in manifest.
- Redaction: PII (names, email addresses, IP addresses) must be removed or tokenized; if tokenized, supply a one-line method description (e.g., SHA-256 salt + stable pseudonym).
- Custody attestation: Single line in the manifest from an owner stating: "I certify this artifact was collected and redacted in accordance with NovaCorp policy."

We can accept an initial package for triage on Mon 17 Aug. If you can upload a small bundle by end-of-day Mon, we'll prioritize redaction review and give a day-1 acceptance note.
